t: A pocket LoRa mesh messenger with a full keyboard, color screen, and GPS.
steps: Buy the Meshtastic or MeshCore edition from Elecrow and pick the radio band for your country.
Charge the battery with the included USB-C cable.
Turn it on and set your region and name in the Meshtastic menus.
Send a test message to another nearby node.
Install the Meshtastic phone app and pair it over Bluetooth for extra settings.
Share your GPS location on a group channel.
Use only M9-specific firmware builds for any update.
